Question: Policy on sick leave
Answer:

Document 2: In case of prolonged illness, it is important to keep the employer informed about your condition and follow up with regular check-ins at regular intervals until you are fully fit again.

Document 3: Sick leave is granted to ensure that employees do not fall sick while on duty or to ensure their speedy return to health and work.
